findings.message: The diff deletes the stale-version assertions: re-recording the author verdict at version 0.9, then expecting zero new requests, a `decision-<id>` commit, and a record body naming both 0.9 and 1.0. Criterion 5 requires every assertion other than the author-verdict expectations to stay unchanged, and the ticket says the stale-version rule is unchanged. The diff removes the rule's coverage.
findings.paved_road: Keep the stale-version check.
